mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a monthly reading, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a threshold signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: The interaction of HOUST and RSAFS declines does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing supply chain disruption (INDPRO growth below 0.5% monthly), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: In the regime of INDPRO growth below 0.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts level below 1,200,000 units (HOUST < 1200) signals weak consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is below 1200, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for HOUST as a threshold signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized change > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the regime of CPIAUCSL annualized change > 3.0%, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment above 150,000 per month (PAYEMS > 150000) signals a strong labor market that supports consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate a stagflationary environment, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decline from prior quarter and CPIAUCSL rise from prior month
failure_condition: The interaction of GDPC1 decline and CPIAUCSL rise does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.
